claims: Orthogonal/source realizations remain admissible as teacher, bridge and compatibility evidence.

Once target admissibility A0-A8 is imposed, target collapse is no longer an arbitrary choice among rasterizers: the unique outer primitive-support frontier selects the canonical Enterprise native endpoint orbit.
The inherited C_s family belongs to the finite-precision/readout layer because its law explicitly depends on subdivision s and majority coverage.
The canonical target state is selected by target fixed-length turn semantics plus primitive-support frontier rigidity, not by source Euclidean equal-distance or classical circumference.
The BRC bridge may compare source/orthogonal realizations to the canonical target state, but it does not generate the Enterprise coordinate system or redefine the native length class.
scope_guard: This is a theorem about the frozen R059D admissible class and inherited N/C_s resolver family. It is not a theorem that every imaginable discretization algorithm must equal N.
